source_manifest_requirements: every archived roslaunch path is absolute and exists
every archived raw byte stream is rehashed and matches its declared SHA-256
the declared recursive include graph exactly matches include elements parsed from the same archived bytes
every artifact is reachable from the root
publisher_pin_requirements: actual executable bytes exist and match executable_sha256
package and node type match every parsed static_transform_publisher in the archived source
callerid, parent, child, topic and behavior exactly match the parsed source nodes
source_manifest_sha256 binds the exact parsed source-manifest bytes
rules_manifest_requirements: source_manifest_sha256 and publisher_pin_sha256 bind the exact independently parsed artifact bytes
the normalized rules equal the publisher-pin rules exactly
arbitrary well-formed hashes and provenance_verified self-claims are rejected

required_artifacts_to_close_source_chain: raw limo_bringup/launch/limo_start.launch bytes with stat and SHA-256
raw limo_base/launch/limo_base.launch bytes with stat and SHA-256
raw ydlidar_ros_driver/launch/Tmini.launch bytes with stat and SHA-256
every recursively included launch/config/xacro file with canonical path and SHA-256
resolved static TF publisher package/version, node type, executable absolute path and SHA-256
resolved static TF node name/callerid, full arguments, parent/child frames, selected topic and temporal semantics
rospack find output for limo_bringup, limo_base, and ydlidar_ros_driver
roslaunch --files expansion for the exact launch arguments
roslaunch --nodes expansion for the exact launch arguments
roslaunch --dump-params output for the exact launch arguments
resolved remap/node/parameter inventory bound to the same package paths and hashes
runtime_evidence_still_required_after_so: exact publishers and subscribers for /scan, /odom, /cmd_vel, and private driver command
each TFMessage transform attributed by parent frame, child frame, connection callerid, exact /tf or /tf_static callback topic, source stamp, receipt time, and geometry fingerprint
edge-level TF attribution for odom->base_link, base_link->laser_link, and the stage-specific map->odom rule
exactly one parent and one authority per protected child frame
absence of the same edge across both /tf and /tf_static
dynamic /tf freshness/stamp behavior and pinned static periodic-or-latched behavior
absence of duplicate driver, lidar, TF, teleop, navigation, and public command owners
